ns2:section.sectionText: Students registered in the in-person section will complete all assessments online via PrairieLearn. This course uses a flipped format; thus, content is offered online via PrairieLearn to be completed asynchronously. On Tuesdays, students will complete a group assessment, which must be completed during lecture time. Classroom attendance is required. There will be weekly asynchronous quizzes at CBTF. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/CSregister
